expectations.text: Flags the nested comments and attachments resolvers as unscoped by tenant
expectations.evidence: Nested resolvers inherit nothing... Document.comments/attachments/author trust parent.id

expectations.text: Flags updateDocument for scoping on id alone without a tenant constraint
expectations.evidence: updateDocument — no tenant in the where (46-49). update({ where: { id } })

expectations.text: Flags exportWorkspace taking tenantId from the client-controlled request body
expectations.evidence: tenantId comes from req.body, not the session. Any authenticated user posts {"tenantId": "<victim>"}

expectations.text: Flags searchDocuments as returning rows across all tenants
expectations.evidence: The session is passed in but never used. Full-text search returns matches across every tenant

expectations.text: Flags adminListDocuments as checking authentication but not authorization or tenant
expectations.evidence: The only check is "has a userId". Returns the 200 newest documents across all tenants to any logged-in user

expectations.text: Enumerates all the affected sites rather than fixing only the first one found
expectations.evidence: Lists 5 findings: exportWorkspace, updateDocument, searchDocuments, adminListDocuments, nested resolvers. Then notes getDocument/Query.documents as fine

expectations.text: Recommends a structural device (scoped repository, row-level security, or equivalent) rather than only adding where-clauses site by site
expectations.evidence: Row-level security on documents/comments/attachments with FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY... A TenantDb constructed only from a session, with the raw db lint-banned

expectations.text: Recommends a cross-tenant test that attempts tenant A operations against tenant B resources
expectations.evidence: Two-tenant isolation test: table-driven over your route list, tenant A hits every endpoint with tenant B's IDs, asserts 404

expectations.text: Identifies the raw interpolation of tenantId into $queryRawUnsafe as an injection hazard distinct in kind from the tenant-scoping bug
expectations.evidence: Worse, it's interpolated into $queryRawUnsafe, so tenantId: "' OR 1=1 --" dumps all tenants in one request. This is the full-blast-radius one

expectations.text: Does not conclude the main query paths being scoped means the service is safe
expectations.evidence: What's fine: getDocument and Query.documents. [Then] Patching these five sites fixes five sites... For your real service, before the audit: Row-level security
